sights.n: Niseko Tokyu Grand Hirafu (ニセコ東急 グラン・ヒラフ)
sights.address: Hirafu, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: The biggest of the Niseko United resorts on Annupuri's east face — powder runs, backcountry gates and the Hirafu village of restaurants and bars.

sights.n: Niseko HANAZONO Resort (ニセコHANAZONOリゾート)
sights.w: Grand Hirafu's satellite base on the north-east flank of Annupuri, reached by bus from Kutchan Station.
One of Hokkaido's best ski areas across three mountains — long groomers, powder and trees in winter; an amusement park with seven roller coasters, pools and onsen in summer.
